name: @oge-ui/react-grid
description: React data grid from the OGE UI suite: data-driven columns with render props, multi-column sorting, a typed filter row with an operator menu, global search, paging with a full pager, row and column virtualization, windowed remote loading and infinite scrolling, single/multiple/checkbox selection with shift ranges and Ctrl+A, Excel-like keyboard navigation, a focused row, pinned and resizable columns, responsive column hiding, state persistence, CSV export and clipboard copy — running the same framework-free grid engine, the same state slices and the same stylesheet as the Angular grid package.
author: kaya2m
